registry: User-provided Excel examples (COB Canada) -- the cross-reference point of truth
note: Append-only list of figures the user produced in their OWN Excel spreadsheet (which the user names the point of truth for COB-ts), plus pending cases awaiting that Excel. This is not the reference workbook (Cost of Borrowing Rate Calc_Current.xlsm) and not a macro-oracle output. Owner: architect (spec docs/new-req/014-b39-monthly-conversion-variable-personal-loan.md, section 'Registry'). Consumed by COB-ts (tests/ca/b39-monthly-conversion.test.ts via a byte-identical copy in tests/ca/fixtures/). COB-py, COB-xlsx and app/engine do not consume it yet (Q-B39-ENGINES).
howToAdd: 1. Append a new object to 'examples'. Never edit or delete an existing entry's input, excel or received fields. Ids are never reused: confirmed examples UX-NNN, pending cases UX-PNN, next free number.

2. Record every engine input in the 'input' shape (same keys as COB-ts tests/ca/fixtures/b37_leap_n_vectors.json cases: rates in percent, dates as ISO calendar days, fees as amount lists). 'start' is the flow's start date (disbursal / renewal / date of change), 'first' the first or next payment date, 'end' the End date.

3. List in 'stated' the fields the user gave; put every field the user did not give, or gave and then corrected, in 'inferred' with the value used and why. An inferred field is a question for the user until confirmed.

4. Copy the user's Excel figures to 'excel' exactly as given (2 dp). Run the shipped COB-ts engine; put its 2-dp totals in 'expected' and its full-precision figures in 'engineWhenRecorded' (information only, tests do not pin them).

5. status: 'match' when expected equals excel; 'known-gap' when it differs, with gapCents = expected - excel per figure in signed whole cents, and an open item in docs/new-req/008 that names the entry id; 'pending-excel' when no Excel figure exists yet (excel null, expected = the engine's prediction).
6. When the user supplies Excel figures for a pending case, fill 'excel' and 'received' and set the status per rule 5. Keep 'expected' unless the engine is changed by a decision.

7. A new example that contradicts the rule currently decided (status would be 'known-gap', or a pending prediction is refuted) must be logged as an open item in docs/new-req/008-brd-validation-open-items.md and taken to the user. Never silently re-pin 'expected' or change the engine to fit it. After a decision changes the engine, update 'expected' and 'decisions' of every affected entry in the same change and say so in COB-ts/CHANGES.md.
8. Copy this file byte for byte to COB-ts/tests/ca/fixtures/ca_user_excel_examples.json (a test checks the two are identical).

fields.expected: Engine totals at the shipped switches, rounded to 2 dp half away from zero (Excel ROUND). COB-ts test rule: round2(engine) == expected for every entry; and for status match: expected == excel; known-gap: expected == excel + gapCents/100; pending-excel: excel is null.
fields.gapCents: Signed whole cents, expected - excel, per figure. Present only for known-gap.
fields.engineWhenRecorded: Shipped COB-ts state when the entry was last (re)computed: D (days start->end), Y (Excel YEARFRAC basis 1), n (payments per year used in equation 1), the Calculated rate and full-precision totals; preB39 = the same engine with MONTHLY_RATE_CONVERSION false. Information for re-evaluating candidate rules (spec 014 Appendix R); not a test pin.

engineState.computedBy: architect prototype of spec 014 (scratch copy of COB-ts/src/ca); to be reproduced by QA's oracle
